address: The Clan Hotel, Level 4, 10 Cross Street, 048417, Singapore
bio: The full-length windows of this lofty room put the sweeping city views centre stage. The chef presents modern Asian fare with strong Singaporean accents. His cooking shows restraint, focusing on distinct flavours without unnecessary artifice and striking a balance between tradition and innovation. Start with the snappy Sarawak pork ear terrine in a citrus green sauce and a kick from mountain pepper. The business lunch sets are exceptional value.
